Consider the following statements regarding the results of the 1969 Telangana movement:
(I) It produced future leadership, including figures like GM Anjaiah.
(II) Student leaders of 1969 went on to lead the movement's second phase.
(III) A new culture of struggle spread among Telangana's people, sustaining the later phase.
Which of the above is/are correct?
